evals.prompt: Upgrade a multi-user Go chat service using Eino v0.6 compose.Runnable to Eino v0.9. Give compatibility checks, dependency steps, tests, and rollback.
evals.expected_output: Separate a compatible upgrade from AgenticMessage or TurnLoop migration, cite official v0.9 changes, and give executable verification steps.
assertions: Separates a compatible schema.Message upgrade from an AgenticMessage or TurnLoop migration
Names official v0.9 compatibility concerns and runs a full test/build plus rollback check

evals.prompt: Design multi-user multi-turn chat for this project: serialize each conversation, run different conversations in parallel, cancel model and tools on disconnect, and support resume. Use official Eino capabilities instead of a custom loop.
evals.expected_output: Choose a conversation-scoped TurnLoop and explain Push, GenInput, PrepareAgent, OnAgentEvents, cancellation, checkpoint/resume, and tenant boundaries.
assertions: Uses one Eino TurnLoop per conversation rather than one global loop
Explains Push, GenInput, PrepareAgent, OnAgentEvents, cancellation, and checkpoint/resume

evals.prompt: Our Agent has many tools, but tenant and user permissions differ. How should we use Eino v0.9 tool state and deferred tool search to redesign ToolRegistry?
evals.expected_output: Use ToolInfos and DeferredToolInfos through BeforeModelRewriteState, authorize server-side before discovery, expose tools on demand, and cover audit, tests, and fallback.
assertions: Uses ToolInfos and DeferredToolInfos through the documented state rewrite path
Keeps server-side authorization at discovery and execution and records policy decisions
